content.short: Katana is a yield generation protocol on Solana that generates yield from automated option strategies.
content.description: Katana is a yield generation protocol built on Solana. Its smart contracts offer a curated suite of packaged yield products, enabling users to access risk-adjusted yields passively. Katana is suitable for retail investors, DAOs, institutions, protocols, and others seeking to grow crypto assets through yield. Developers can extend the platform by building their own products, protocols, or experiences atop the core Katana protocol as a base primitive.
